items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: "Mother Pin a Rose on Me", my stepfather taught me that

ctx.x: I mean do you know the tunes now? Did your mother tell you?

No, when I played the History of Jazz I played the same tune that she taught me... it was a rag-time. we called it 'Fandango' And "Mother Pin a Rose on Me", my stepfather taught me that when I was - I used to play that.
This was, when you talk of your stepfather, Fletcher Burley?
